itineraryDays.title: Arrival Cochin & Scenic Transfer to Munnar (130 km / 4 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Warm welcome by our chauffeur at Cochin Airport/Railway Station. Drive through cascading Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check in at your Munnar tea plantation resort. Evening free to stroll through local tea markets.

itineraryDays.title: Full Day Munnar Exploration & Tea Museum
itineraryDays.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr), Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, and the Tata Tea Museum. Experience a panoramic photo stop amidst lush undulating tea gardens.

itineraryDays.title: Munnar to Thekkady Spice Sanctuary (90 km / 3 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Scenic drive through the Western Ghats to Thekkady (Periyar). Check in to hotel. Afternoon guided spice plantation walk discovering cardamom, pepper, and cinnamon. Optional evening Periyar Lake boat safari and Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

itineraryDays.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Backwaters & Private Houseboat Cruise (140 km / 4 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Journey to the Venice of the East. Board your traditional Kerala Kettuvallam (Houseboat) at 12:00 PM. Cruise along serene palm-fringed canals, paddy fields, and lagoons. Relish freshly prepared traditional Kerala lunch and dinner onboard.
itineraryDays.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, Dinner (Full Board on Houseboat)

itineraryDays.title: Alleppey to Kovalam Beach via Trivandrum (160 km / 4.5 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Disembark houseboat after breakfast. Drive to Kovalam beach town. Enroute visit the sacred Padmanabhaswamy Temple and Napier Museum in Trivandrum. Evening at leisure on Lighthouse Beach watching the Arabian Sea sunset.

itineraryDays.title: Excursion to Kanyakumari (Southern Tip of India) & Return to Kovalam
itineraryDays.description: Day trip to Kanyakumari (90 km). Visit Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Thiruvalluvar Statue via ferry, and Gandhi Memorial Mandapam. Witness the confluence of the Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal. Return to Kovalam for night stay.

itineraryDays.title: Kovalam to Trivandrum Airport Departure
itineraryDays.description: Enjoy a relaxing morning at the beach. Check out from the resort and transfer to Trivandrum Airport (TRV) with cherished memories of your joyful Varni Holidays vacation.

itineraryDays.title: Arrival Cochin & Scenic Transfer to Munnar (130 km / 4 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Warm welcome by our chauffeur at Cochin Airport/Railway Station. Drive through cascading Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check in at your Munnar tea plantation resort. Evening free to stroll through local tea markets.

itineraryDays.title: Full Day Munnar Exploration & Tea Museum
itineraryDays.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr), Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, and the Tata Tea Museum. Experience a panoramic photo stop amidst lush undulating tea gardens.

itineraryDays.title: Munnar to Thekkady Spice Sanctuary (90 km / 3 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Scenic drive through the Western Ghats to Thekkady (Periyar). Check in to hotel. Afternoon guided spice plantation walk discovering cardamom, pepper, and cinnamon. Optional evening Periyar Lake boat safari and Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

itineraryDays.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Backwaters & Private Houseboat Cruise (140 km / 4 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Journey to the Venice of the East. Board your traditional Kerala Kettuvallam (Houseboat) at 12:00 PM. Cruise along serene palm-fringed canals, paddy fields, and lagoons. Relish freshly prepared traditional Kerala lunch and dinner onboard.
itineraryDays.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, Dinner (Full Board on Houseboat)

itineraryDays.title: Alleppey to Kovalam Beach via Trivandrum (160 km / 4.5 hrs)
itineraryDays.description: Disembark houseboat after breakfast. Drive to Kovalam beach town. Enroute visit the sacred Padmanabhaswamy Temple and Napier Museum in Trivandrum. Evening at leisure on Lighthouse Beach watching the Arabian Sea sunset.

itineraryDays.title: Excursion to Kanyakumari (Southern Tip of India) & Return to Kovalam
itineraryDays.description: Day trip to Kanyakumari (90 km). Visit Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Thiruvalluvar Statue via ferry, and Gandhi Memorial Mandapam. Witness the confluence of the Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal. Return to Kovalam for night stay.

itineraryDays.title: Kovalam to Trivandrum Airport Departure
itineraryDays.description: Enjoy a relaxing morning at the beach. Check out from the resort and transfer to Trivandrum Airport (TRV) with cherished memories of your joyful Varni Holidays vacation.
